Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the ultimate parent company (CK Asset Holdings, based in Hong Kong) with the actual owning company of the Hungry Horse chain (Greene King), despite WebSurfer evidence showing Greene King as the owner and based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk. This misinterpretation of corporate hierarchy led to providing the parent’s HQ instead of the owner’s base location requested by the task.
